theme_cn: AI口语 + 高频词汇 + 阅读理解 + 键盘拼写

speaking.sentence: Would you like to travel to space? Why or why not?
speaking.sentence_cn: 你想去太空旅行吗？为什么想，或者为什么不想？
options: Yes, I would love to, because I want to see the Earth from above.
Space is very far away from us.
I watched a film about space last night.
There are many stars in the sky.
options_cn: 想，我很愿意，因为我想从上面看看地球。
太空离我们非常远。
我昨晚看了一部关于太空的电影。
天空中有很多星星。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: would /wʊd/ 注意不要读成 will，from above 连读 /frəməˈbʌv/
speaking.explanation_cn: Would you like to...? 的答句先用 Yes/No 表态，再给理由。A 表态 + 理由齐全。B、C、D 都没有表态。
speaking.explanation_en: Answer 'Would you like to...?' with Yes or No first, then a reason. A does both; B, C and D never say whether they want to go.
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 先回答 Yes I would 或 No I wouldn't，再用 because 说理由。

speaking.sentence: What do you usually do after dinner?
options: I usually take a walk with my dog and then read for a while.
I had dinner at half past six.
Dinner is the biggest meal of the day.
options_cn: 我通常和狗一起散散步，然后看一会儿书。
我六点半吃的晚饭。
晚饭是一天中最大的一餐。
我妈妈做饭很好吃。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: usually /ˈjuːʒuəli/，take a walk 连读自然，for a while 意为「一会儿」
speaking.explanation_cn: 问「通常做什么」，要用一般现在时 + usually。A 说了两个习惯动作。B 说昨天几点吃饭；C 是常识；D 说的是妈妈。
speaking.explanation_en: The question asks about a habit, so use the simple present with 'usually'. A lists two habits; B talks about one evening, C is a general fact and D describes the mother.
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 答句要说出习惯做的事，动词用原形，可以加 usually、often。

speaking.sentence: How do you keep healthy in winter?
options: I drink warm water, wear thick clothes and go to bed early.
I was ill last winter for a week.
options_cn: 我喝温水、穿厚衣服，还很早睡觉。
冬天比秋天冷。
去年冬天我病了一个星期。
很多人喜欢雪。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: thick /θɪk/ 舌尖轻触上齿，healthy /ˈhelθi/ 注意 th 音
speaking.explanation_cn: 问「怎么保持健康」，要给出具体做法。A 给了三条：喝温水、穿厚衣、早睡。B 讲天气；C 说生病；D 说别人喜欢雪。
speaking.explanation_en: The question asks for ways to stay healthy, so list concrete habits. A gives three; B describes the weather, C mentions being ill and D talks about other people.
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用一般现在时说出两三个做法，比如 drink warm water、wear thick clothes。

speaking.sentence: What is the best way for you to learn new words?
speaking.sentence_cn: 对你来说，学新单词最好的方法是什么？
options: The best way for me is to use them in a sentence of my own.
There are many words in English.
I learned twenty words last week.
options_cn: 对我来说最好的方法是用它们造一个自己的句子。
英语里有很多单词。
我上周学了二十个单词。
我的词典很重。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: sentence /ˈsentəns/ 重音在前，of my own 连读
speaking.explanation_cn: 问「最好的方法」，答句要用 The best way is to... 给出方法。A 正确（自己造句）。B、C、D 都没给方法。
speaking.explanation_en: The question asks for the best method, so answer with 'The best way is to...'. A gives a method; the others give facts instead.
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 用 The best way for me is to + 动词原形，说一个具体做法。

speaking.sentence: Who do you admire most, and why?
options: I admire my grandfather, because he taught himself English at sixty.
There are five people in my family.
My teacher gave us a lot of homework.
I met him at the school gate.
options_cn: 我敬佩我爷爷，因为他六十岁自学了英语。
我家有五口人。
老师给我们布置了很多作业。
我在校门口遇见了他。
speaking.pronunciation_tips: admire /ədˈmaɪə/ 重音在第二音节，himself 注意重读 self
speaking.explanation_cn: 要求介绍一个敬佩的人，要说出是谁 + 为什么。A 说了 grandfather 和原因。B 说家里人数；C 说作业；D 说见面地点。
speaking.explanation_en: Name the person and explain why you admire them. A gives both; B, C and D do not describe anyone you admire.
speaking.answer_cn_hint: 先说是谁，再用 because 说一件他做过的事，这样最有说服力。

vocab.example_en: The astronaut waved to us from the window.
vocab.example_cn: 宇航员从窗口向我们挥手。

vocab.example_en: Water floats in the air because it is weightless there.
vocab.example_cn: 水在空中飘着，因为那里是失重的。
vocab.hint_cn: 在太空里身体轻飘飘的

vocab.example_en: The team finished the six-month mission in space.
vocab.example_cn: 这支队伍完成了为期六个月的太空任务。
vocab.hint_cn: 上头交给你必须完成的一件事

vocab.example_en: The phone signal is weak in the mountains.
vocab.hint_cn: 手机格数变少时说的那个词

vocab.example_en: We did the water test in the school laboratory.
vocab.example_cn: 我们在学校实验室做了水质测试。

spell.question: 宇航员：a________ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: astro 表示「星星」，naut 表示「航行的人」，读 /ˈæstrənɔːt/。

spell.question: 失重的：w_________ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: weight（重量）+ less（没有）= 失重的，读 /ˈweɪtləs/。

spell.question: 任务：m______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: mission 结尾是 sion，读 /ʃn/，注意两个 s。

spell.question: 信号：s______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: signal 中间是 gn，g 不发音，读 /ˈsɪɡnəl/。

mc.question: —Which one would you like, coffee or orange juice? —___. I just want something to eat.
mc.explanation_cn: 咖啡和橙汁两个都不要 → Neither（两者都不）；Both 是两个都要。

mc.question: This is my brother. ___ name is Tom.
mc.explanation_cn: 修饰名词 name 要用形容词性物主代词 His；he 是主格、him 是宾格。

mc.question: My best friend is Alice. ___ is a dancer.
mc.explanation_cn: 作主语用主格 She；her 是宾格，hers 是名词性物主代词。

mc.question: The pencil is ___. Tom left it here yesterday.
mc.explanation_cn: "是他的"后面不再跟名词 → 名词性物主代词 his。

mc.question: ___ father is a pilot. I admire him very much.
mc.explanation_cn: 修饰名词 father 用形容词性物主代词 My（我的）。

mc2.question: 词组补充——野生动物：wild ___
mc2.explanation_cn: wild animals 野生动物；animal 泛指一类用复数。

mc2.question: 词组补充——有能力做某事：be ___ to do sth
mc2.explanation_cn: be able to do sth 有能力做某事。

mc2.question: 词组补充——课堂活动：classroom ___
mc2.explanation_cn: activity 的复数：y 变 i 加 es → activities。

mc2.question: 词组补充——同意：___ with
mc2.explanation_cn: agree with sb 同意某人（的意见）。

mc2.question: 词组补充——很久以前：a long time ___
mc2.explanation_cn: a long time ago 很久以前。

mc2.question: 词组补充——回答问题：___ questions

grammar.question: Are there ___ books on the table?
grammar.explanation_cn: 一般疑问句多用 any，但说话人盼着回答"有"、或是在提议时，问句也用 some。

grammar.question: You can take ___ photos in the park.
grammar.explanation_cn: 向对方提议、提供东西时用 some。

grammar.question: Can I ask you ___ questions?
grammar.explanation_cn: Can I…? 是向别人提请求，希望对方说"好"，用 some 不用 any。

grammar.question: There are ___ interesting places in this city.
grammar.explanation_cn: 肯定陈述句用 some；places 可数复数，be 动词用 are。
